content.short: walletOS is a single API to simplify blockchain development, providing a unified interface for blockchain interactions across 18+ networks.
content.description: walletOS provides a single API to streamline blockchain development. It exposes a defined set of endpoints for all blockchain interactions across 18+ networks, giving developers a uniform API interface that hides chain-specific complexities. By standardizing common data shapes and calls, teams can devote more time to their core product rather than network-specific integration work. Typical use cases include transfers, staking, and smart contract interactions across the supported networks.
